name: Prosciutto & Provolone Croissant Roll-Up
whyItWorks: Refined white pastry flour and aged cheese dissolve fast; thin cured meat gives high protein and sodium without tough muscle fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin prosciutto and plain provolone or Havarti inside a bakery croissant. Toast in the toaster oven at 350F for 4-5 minutes until flaky, never soggy.
